_comment: Concrete ids for the mobile app's dynamic routes, so the dogfood sweep exercises them instead of skipping them. Before this file existed the sweep's route list was a hand-made /tmp file that simply omitted all 8 dynamic routes, so every detail screen in the app was unmeasured while the summary still read '223 routes'.
_ownership: EVERY id here must belong to whichever user the SIMULATOR is signed in as. The API scopes by owner and answers 404 for someone else's row, which is indistinguishable from a broken screen. These ids belong to dogios@fynvita.test (0ae37503-d192-4bdf-acd9-cd7dc169103a) and were read out of the local database, not invented. Unlike the web sweep, this one cannot preflight the match: it does not perform the login, it reads whatever session Expo Go already holds. If the simulator is signed in as someone else, expect these routes to report their not-found state.
_unseeded: /monitoring/alerts/[id] has no entry on purpose: credit_alerts holds zero rows for this user, and an id from another user would produce a not-found that reads exactly like a broken screen. It is reported as UNSEEDED so the gap stays visible rather than being quietly dropped.
_reseed: Re-seed after `supabase db reset` — see scripts/dogfood-seed.sql in the repo root. A stale id shows up as a not-found state, not a silent pass.
